mathematical_findings.pair_formula: Correct. With C=eta*0.96*500/400, lag>=0 P=C*(500/600-1/2)*exp(-lag/100); N=-C*(500/600*exp(-lag/500)-1/2*exp(-lag/100)); negative lag exchanges magnitudes. Net=eta*sign(lag)*(exp(-abs(lag)/100)-exp(-abs(lag)/500)).
mathematical_findings.coincidence: P=0.0002, N=-0.0002, net=0. Both areas retained.
mathematical_findings.linearity: For fixed histories, constant nonnegative normalized per-edge DAN coefficients produce a convex combination of individual signed bases while gain bounds do not intervene. Allowing different coefficients on every trial enlarges the class; exclusion in this larger class excludes the fixed class.
mathematical_findings.sample_sd: Sample SD is a convex centered Euclidean norm; a maximum over the trial box is attained at a vertex. All 256 vertices are evaluated.
mathematical_findings.prefix_margin: P+abs(N)+2*AREA_ATOL+1.5*gamma_1501+2^-24<0.5 reserves opposing-product numerical allowance, double gain accumulation and inclusive F32 bound contact.
mathematical_findings.publication_envelope: Per-trial expansion n_edges*(2^-24+AREA_ATOL+1.5*gamma_1501)+rho; internal cast float64. rho additionally lowers minimum absolute mean and raises maximum SD.
mathematical_findings.near_equality: Exclusion compares minimum_absolute_mean_lower > 0.5*maximum_sample_sd_upper; equality remains inconclusive. Raw estimates are diagnostic, not conservative fields.
mathematical_findings.canonical_identity: Runner enforces rtol=0 and explicit maximum error <=1e-10; all 32 final home gain vectors must match float32 publication.
mathematical_findings.limits: Numerical allowances are declared comparison envelopes, not a formal arbitrary-prefix or interval-arithmetic proof. Canonical endpoint agreement does not itself prove arbitrary-prefix error. Passing the necessary bound does not construct an anatomical map; exclusion cannot rule out time-varying coupling, receptor dynamics, recurrently changed histories, or biological learning.
